name: mausberry_switch
description: Safely shuts down Volumio with a Mausberry Circuits power switch
author: tomcek42

volumio_info.details: Support for Mausberry Circuits power switches. Installs the mausberry-switch daemon (libgpiod based), which watches the switch and powers off the Raspberry Pi safely. The GPIO pins and the shutdown delay can be set on the plugin settings page.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.1: Plugin category system_hardware; the daemon starts only when the plugin is enabled. 1.0.0: Initial release, installs mausberry-switch 0.9.5
